email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with severe abdominal pain radiating to the back
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 60-year-old male patient with a history of hypertension received their second dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 25mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-06-06.
Approximately 10 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed severe abdominal pain radiating to the back.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
R. Silva (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
Contact: demo.reporter671@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
